statBlock.name: Cosmotronic Blastseeker
statBlock.description: An Izzet field tester who uses experimental gear to push spell damage beyond its usual limits.

sections.Traits:
Empowered Spell (3/day). When rolling a spell’s damage, reroll as many as four of its damage dice. Use the results of the rerolls.
Tides of Chaos (1/day). Make an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw with advantage.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Intelligence sets the spell save DC at 14 and the spell attack bonus at +6. It uses its own Izzet gear to cast. It needs no other components, and the gear does not work for other creatures.
3/day each. Scorching Ray, Shield, Thunderwave.
2/day. Fireball.
sections.Actions: Warhammer. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) if wielded with two hands.

statBlock.name: Counterflux Blastseeker
statBlock.description: An Izzet field tester whose overcasting can make an area more or less susceptible to magic.

sections.Traits: Counterflux Overcast (Recharge 5–6). Immediately after it casts a spell, the blastseeker can create an invisible 15-ft.-radius sphere centered on itself. The sphere lasts until the end of the blastseeker’s next turn. Roll a d6 when creating it. On 1–3, creatures inside have disadvantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. On 4–6, those creatures have advantage on those saves.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Intelligence sets the spell save DC at 14 and the spell attack bonus at +6. It uses its own Izzet gear to cast. It needs no other components, and the gear does not work for other creatures.
3/day each. Enlarge/Reduce, Mage Armor (self only), Scorching Ray.
1/day each. Counterspell, Dispel Magic, Protection from Energy.
sections.Actions: Rapier. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

statBlock.name: Flux Blastseeker
statBlock.description: An Izzet field tester whose overcasting can swap two creatures’ positions or release a thunderous pulse.

sections.Traits: Fluxbending Overcast (Recharge 5–6). Immediately after it casts a spell, the blastseeker can roll a d6 for an additional effect. On 1–3, it teleports and switches places with a creature it can see within 30 ft. On 4–6, the blastseeker and each creature within 10 ft. of it must pass a DC 16 Constitution save or take 11 (2d10) thunder damage.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Intelligence sets the spell save DC at 16 and the spell attack bonus at +8. It uses its own Izzet gear to cast. It needs no other components, and the gear does not work for other creatures.
3/day each. Mage Armor (self only), Scorching Ray.
1/day each. Banishment, Cone of Cold, Dimension Door, Fireball, Ice Storm.
sections.Actions: Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, or 4 (1d8) if wielded with two hands.

statBlock.name: Galvanic Blastseeker
statBlock.description: An Izzet field tester who channels lightning through experimental gear and moves on brief gusts of air.

sections.Languages: Common, Primordial, and one other language.
sections.Traits:
Galvanic Overcast (Recharge 5–6). When casting Lightning Bolt or Thunderwave, the blastseeker can roll a die. On an odd result, the blastseeker takes 9 (2d8) force damage. On an even result, each target that fails its save against the spell also takes 9 (2d8) lightning damage.
Heart of the Storm. Whenever the blastseeker casts Lightning Bolt or Thunderwave, it deals 3 lightning damage to every other creature within 10 ft.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Intelligence sets the spell save DC at 15 and the spell attack bonus at +7. It uses its own Izzet gear to cast. It needs no other components, and the gear does not work for other creatures.
3/day each. Levitate, Lightning Bolt, Thunderwave.
1/day. Stoneskin.
sections.Actions: Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 3 (1d6) piercing damage, or 4 (1d8) when wielded with two hands for a melee attack.
sections.Bonus actions: Gust-Propelled Leap. Fly up to 10 ft. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.
